method: For each of exactly 18 holes, validate par 3-5, gross score 1-30 and a unique stroke index from 1 through 18. A nonnegative playing handicap h allocates floor(h/18) strokes to every hole plus one extra where stroke index is at most h mod 18; h may be 0 through 54. A plus handicap from -1 through -18 instead allocates one negative stroke on each hole whose stroke index is at most abs(h). Net score is gross score minus allocated strokes. Stableford points are max(0, 2 + par - net score), without an artificial upper cap. Totals and front/back-nine points are integer sums. The input must already be the applicable playing handicap; handicap allowances, unplayed holes and committee adjustments are outside the model.

sources.title: The R&A, Rules of Golf, Rule 21.1: Stableford scoring and application of handicap strokes
